services.desc: Just an easy sail to the diving, dolphin and cruising areas, our spacious 48-foot sailing catamaran was custom built for snorkeling, day charters and private gathering for 40 guests. Southern Wave’s design with its 25’ beam, provides a safe, spacious open environment for passengers to experience state-of-the-art catamaran sailing while enjoying the scenic beauty of South Padre Island, Laguna Madre and the Gulf of Mexico. Considering options for team building or leisure? A cruise on the Southern Wave Catamaran offers the perfect setting. Allow us to cater to your hardworking team.
